summary:
Recommendation: move the shop MySQL database to two AWS services in two waves. Wave 1 moves it to Aurora MySQL, which ends up serving 33.3% of the queries; wave 2 moves 66.7% of the queries to DynamoDB. The projected cost of the full modernization is $20 per month at on-demand list prices. No current cost was collected for the source database, so the plan claims no saving against it.

Risk: overall risk is low. The main exposure is a low-severity risk of slower performance on DynamoDB: review it in the risk register before wave 2 starts.

Decision: approve wave 1. It is safe to approve: it moves the database 1:1 to Aurora MySQL, the same engine family as MySQL, with its current data model, and its cutover waits until schema and data parity is validated against the source.
